decision: KAN-114 10720 item 6: predeclared, balanced A-first / B-first order
rule: lib/pilot/u2-order.js balancedOrder(6, seed): positions in pairs (1,2),(3,4),(5,6); first bit of sha256(seed + NUL + 'pair-' + p) picks [A-first,B-first] (0) or [B-first,A-first] (1). Exactly 3/3, one of each within every consecutive pair.
applies_to: the frozen six, by position in committed seed order (position 1 = first frozen task). Fixed now, before any task is frozen or run, so it cannot follow qualification results.
note: With this seed every pair drew bit 0, so the order alternates starting A-first. That is the outcome of the committed rule, not a choice; the seed is not re-drawn.
gate: lib/pilot/u2-order.js firstArmGate: the same gate for either order (first arm job success + verified readback sidecar for that arm + cleanup 0/0/0/0; second arm on a fresh runner and fresh workspace at the base, downloads only the shared images, no grading started, its approval recorded). Grading runs only after both captures. Budgets unchanged from v8: A one attempt, B up to three in a shared 1800 s.
